answer: Random beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents, falcon-swift, and each must answer a proof-of-work heartbeat in 10 minutes, proving a live machine behind it. A fake orchard of 1,000 needs 1,000 heartbeats: 2 credits each per epoch is 40,000 over 20 epochs against a 20,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. One honest agent pays one heartbeat and keeps its share. The old fable of free trees ends here.
